items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The second week I was in New York, a guy approached me who had been...my Uncle Paul had introduced me to. His name was Harry White.

ctx.x: Yes, Paul Barbarin. This guy's name was Harry White. He had been one of the original trombone players with Duke Ellington. He'd come out of Washington. He was a member of the White Brothers Band. Eddie and three
